scope: Independent local code and deterministic test audit of the Routing release/recovery capstone and comparison publication reuse.
checks: Regression cohort selects the lexical first review-pool case per training intent before release predictions; official-test stages remain unchanged.
Exact version bundles preserve classifier, preprocessing and encoder identity, probability-column order, learner policy, learner classifier source, and prediction runtime.
A new prediction refuses changed installed runtime or data. Completed cached batches remain reusable.
Controlled label rotation preserves probabilities while changing destination names. The learner loader and release checker execute on the repaired batch.
Deterministic two-intent fixture demonstrates healthy 1.0, faulty 0.0, and repaired 1.0 accuracy; this is a test fixture, not a live Banking77 result.
Rollback verifies prediction parity before recording success. Rejection retains the earlier release without requiring publication of a selected repair.
Release navigation remains incomplete until rejection or matching, verified rollback.
Completed upload receipts survive SDK run-close errors. Restarting reuses completed batches without training or provider requests.
Adding a comparison version reuses sibling run/evaluation receipts. Failed native publication retries only that service. Aggregate summary corrections do not repeat prediction evaluations.
Evaluation-row evidence is fixed at first publication; late verified export links are available in notebook/report links without duplicating saved evaluation rows.
Report text distinguishes the controlled regression set from independent official-test results and only describes rollback after verified completion.
Reactive completion callbacks use functional state updates rather than reading the state they write.

local_markdown_links.scope: File existence for relative/absolute local Markdown links in changed/new docs. External URLs and Slidev named route links were excluded.

limitations: This receipt does not claim a complete live browser path, external-account access check, or human usability rehearsal.
This audit did not publish native services. Root-session live browser/publication results are recorded separately.
Embedding reproduction uses the pinned cached encoder features; batch latency excludes encoding.
Saved model files use joblib and must come from a trusted source. This is a notebook batch release exercise, not a deployed production endpoint.
Review-pool requests may have been accepted into development training. They are regression/reproduction cases, not an independent test set.
